The Mad Inspector

A chaotic VR inspection game where every person could be hiding something unexpected.

Step into a stylized VR world as a street inspector. Search suspicious characters, confiscate strange and illegal items, make decisions, earn money, upgrade your setup and survive escalating chaos.

Confiscate strange items

Survive escalating police raids
